g.text: in one sentence, what is a GGUF file?
The user asked for one sentence, so no preamble. Lead with what the
actually is - a container for the weights - then the part they
is what lets a quantised model load quickly and run on
own. Expanding the acronym would spend the
sentence on trivia they did not ask
A GGUF file is a single-file container holding an LLM's weights and
metadata needed to load them, usually quantised so the model fits
and runs on ordinary CPUs and consumer GPUs.
